name: remittance-statement
title: Remittance statement
for_each: select r.id, r.ref || ' ' || c.code as name from remittances r join clients c on c.id = r.client_id order by r.made_on

sections.title: Summary
sections.sql: select c.name as client, r.ref, r.period_to, r.made_on, c.currency, r.trust_cents, r.direct_cents, r.commission_cents, r.gst_cents, r.net_cents, r.reference from remittances r join clients c on c.id = r.client_id where r.id = $1

sections.title: Payments in this remittance
sections.note: Direct payments went straight to you; commission on them is netted off here.
sections.sql: select t.occurred_on as date, a.ref, a.client_ref, d.name as debtor, t.method, c.currency, t.amount_cents, t.commission_cents from transactions t join accounts a on a.id = t.account_id join debtors d on d.id = a.debtor_id join clients c on c.id = a.client_id where t.remittance_id = $1 order by t.occurred_on, a.ref

name: client-listing
title: Client account listing
for_each: select id, code || ' ' || name as name from clients order by code

sections.title: Open accounts
sections.sql: select b.ref, a.client_ref, b.debtor, b.status, b.currency, b.listed_cents, b.paid_cents, b.balance_cents, b.last_tried_on from v_balances b join accounts a on a.id = b.account_id where b.client_id = $1 and b.status not in ('paid','returned','closed') order by b.ref

sections.title: Closed, paid and returned
sections.sql: select b.ref, a.client_ref, b.debtor, b.status, a.closed_on, b.currency, b.listed_cents, b.paid_cents, b.balance_cents from v_balances b join accounts a on a.id = b.account_id where b.client_id = $1 and b.status in ('paid','returned','closed') order by a.closed_on desc

name: debtor-statement
title: Statement of account
for_each: select a.id, a.ref || ' ' || d.name as name from accounts a join debtors d on d.id = a.debtor_id where a.status not in ('paid','returned','closed') order by a.ref

sections.title: Account
sections.sql: select a.ref, d.name as debtor, c.name as on_behalf_of, a.client_ref as their_reference, b.currency, b.balance_cents as owing_cents from accounts a join debtors d on d.id = a.debtor_id join clients c on c.id = a.client_id join v_balances b on b.account_id = a.id where a.id = $1

sections.title: Transactions
sections.sql: select t.occurred_on as date, t.kind, t.description, c.currency, t.amount_cents from transactions t join accounts a on a.id = t.account_id join clients c on c.id = a.client_id where t.account_id = $1 order by t.occurred_on, t.created_at
